Scared Boar is on the Ravaged Beach during Act One.

Involvement

Act One

The Scared Boar is near the location of  Astarion's first meeting with the party. The boar is fearful of humanoids and views them as murderous predators, but it can be calmed using  Speak with Animals or passing a  DC 10 Animal Handling Check. Calming the boar grants approval from some of the party members. Alternatively, the boar can be killed for camp supplies. Simply observing the boar causes it to leave peacefully.

Companion approval

The interacting party member can attempt to calm the boar with or without  Speak with Animals.

  • [ANIMAL HANDLING] Raise your palms to calm the boar. (DC 10)
  • Calm down. I won't hurt you.

Any of the above:  +1  +1  +1  +1
